title: oreoseris henryi
intro: Oreoseris henryi, commonly known as the Himalayan fleabane or Himalayan ragwort, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oreoseris henryi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that may contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
